newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair stock down on Sabena tie-in.
newsitem.headline: Swissair stock down on Sabena tie-in.

text.p: Swissair share prices fell in Swiss bourse trade at midday, giving up earlier gains after comments by Sabena chief executive Paul Reutlinger.
Swissair registered shares were down 6.00 Swiss francs versus Wednesday's close at 980 francs just before 1100 GMT, losing ground after Reutlinger's comments.
"Swissair's board of directors has given the authority to Swissair managment to write off its investment (in Sabena) if they think it is necessary," Reutlinger said.
After his comments, however, Swissair said that it planned no decision on any write-off on Sabena before year-end.

Earlier today, Sabena announced a draft plan to restore the airline to profitability by 1998, at a cost of 4.7 billion Belgian francs. It said the provisional deal was reached with four main trade unions.

But members of the pilots' association within the trade unions had pulled out of the negotiations. Reutlinger said he had already informed the pilots of Swissair's possiblity of a write-off and would now start negotations with them.
